findings.title: Payment History lacks a visible entry in billing navigation
Web order history stops at 50 without pagination
Payment reference/details and complete purchased capacity unavailable
Native billing rejects Account-only administrators
findings.policy_update: 2026-11-12: owner forbids Account-only admins creating/renewing subscriptions. Native purchase denial is expected, not a defect. Permission to view history/subscription details remains unspecified; reevaluate only the read gate.
